_comment: US locale pack. SSN has no checksum — us_ssn_range rejects known-invalid area/group/serial ranges. Regex covers dash- and space-separated forms (Microsoft Purview SIT: Func_ssn / Func_randomized_formatted_ssn); bare 9-digit unformatted SSNs are deliberately not matched — Microsoft's own spec only allows that variant alongside keyword-proximity context we don't have infrastructure for yet, and without it the false-positive rate would be unacceptable.
